tokens.npc_dota_hero_undying_bio:
How long has it been since he lost his name? The torn ruin of his mind no longer knows.

Dimly he recalls armor and banners and grim-faced kin riding at his side. He remembers a battle: pain and fear as pale hands ripped him from his saddle. He remembers terror as they threw him into the yawning pit of the Dead God alongside his brothers, to hear the Dirge and be consumed into nothingness. In the darkness below, time left them. Thought left them. Sanity left them. Hunger, however, did not. They turned on each other with split fingernails and shattered teeth. Then it came: distant at first, a fragile note at the edge of perception, joined by another, then another, inescapable and unending. The chorus grew into a living wall of sound pulsing in his mind until no other thought survived. With the Dirge consuming him, he opened his arms to the Dead God and welcomed his obliteration. Yet destruction was not what he'd been chosen for. The Dead God demanded war. In the belly of the great nothing, he was granted a new purpose: to spread the Dirge across the land, to rally the sleepless dead against the living. He was to become the Undying, the herald of the Dead God, to rise and fall and rise again whenever his body failed him. To trudge on through death unending, that the Dirge might never end.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_undying_hype: Shambling into battle, Undying forces enemies to decide whether to flee his wrath or be torn apart by it. He drains strength from his foes, and summons a horde of clawing undead. When he finally becomes a hulking flesh golem, his enemies may already be overwhelmed.

* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}}
*** Both the buff and debuff stacks are applied independently, has its own duration respectively, and have no stack limit.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** Affects the following units:
***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.
**** The {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|undying_decay_debuff}} ability effects are applied as follows:
****# The offensive {{M|strength}} loss, with the following properties:
****#* Cannot reduce the debuff-affected unit's strength below 0.
****#* Considers {{M|clones}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, {{M|illusions}} as creeps.
****#* Reduces the strength value from the following set of units, randomly chosen per ability cast:
****#** {{H|Arc Warden}} and {{M|The Double}}.
****#** {{H|Lone Druid}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}}.
****#** The {{Symbol|Meepo|Prime}} Meepo Prime and its {{A|Meepo|Meepo Clones}}.
****# {{Symbol|Health}}
****#* {{cf|expr}} {{Code|When UnitHP ≤ {{#expr:{{#var:Decay value2}}*{{G|bonus health}}}} OR {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Decay value2 agh}}*{{G|bonus health}}}}|agh|x}}}}, reduces the debuff-affected enemy unit's current [[health]] to 1 at this step.
****# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
****#* Considers {{M|clones}} and {{M|illusions}} as heroes, {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
****# Applies the {{M|current health}} reduction.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
**** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|undying_decay_buff_counter}}
***** Grants flat bonus {{M|strength}} per stack per debuff-affected enemy hero:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Health}}
*** All affected units, including Undying, do not keep the current-to-max health percentage upon the buff and debuff expiration respectively.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** The debuff-affected units do not regain the health loss value.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
**** Hence, it indirectly increases Undying's health upon buff expiration.
**** However, the health increase component does not interact with the following mechanics:
***** [[Restoration manipulation]] sources.
***** [[Health freeze]] sources, except {{A|Oracle|False Promise}}.

* {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
** [[File:Dota2 Undying Soul Rip Targeting Visualized icon-1.png|84px]] 
*** The search radius {{Symbol|Target|Area-Dummy|size=42px}} is centered on Undying while {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} [[File:Dota2 Undying Soul Rip Targeting Visualized icon-2.png|31px]] targeting other units within its {{M|cast range}}.
**** {{M|Doubletap}} casts the ability on Undying.
** Has the following ability interactions with the {{U|Tombstone}}:
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
**** Restores a set hit count on the allied Tombstone regardless of the amount of affected units within the search radius.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** The ability neither damages nor restores the enemy Tombstone.
*** Cannot be cast on the following units:
**** {{U|Undying Zombie}}.
**** Other {{M|ward-type units}}.
 
* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*** The ability effects are applied as follows:
***# Randomly searches for {{#var:Soul Rip value3}} other valid units of all {{M|factions}}, except Undying and the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} targeted unit, within the radius upon cast.
***#* If there are no other valid units within the search radius, the ability does nothing. 
***#* Hence, the ability requires {{#expr:{{#var:Soul Rip value3}}+2}} units, within the search radius to reach max ability values.
***# Applies a {{#var:Soul Rip value4}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2r}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Soul Rip value4 tal}}|15tal}}) health value reduction on all affected units.
***#* Has the following properties:
***#** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
***#*** This ability component affects Undying.
***#** Utilizes the [[setting health]] mechanic and is non-lethal.
***#** Hence, affected units will always have at least 1 {{M|current health}} left.
***# Applies the following ability effects corresponding to the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} targeted unit's {{M|faction}} as follows:
***#* {{cf|expr}} {{Code|AppliedValue {{=}} f(ValidUnits) × {{#var:Soul Rip value4}} OR {{ValueColor||{{#var:Soul Rip value4 tal}}|tal|x}} , MAX f(ValidUnits) {{=}} {{#var:Soul Rip value3}}}}
***#* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
***#** Applies the summed up value as one {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} instance in the {{M|combat log}}.
***#* {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
***#** Applies the summed up value as one {{M|heal}} instance.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
*** Considers the following valid allied units, but not enemy units:
**** {{M|Couriers}}
**** {{M|Spell immune}} units.
**** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
**** {{U|Undying Zombie|text=Undying Zombies}}.
**** Units with hit counts and {{A|Visage|Summon Familiars|text=Familiars}} do not lose health when they are considered by Soul Rip.
*** Does not consider the following units at all:
**** {{M|Buildings}}
**** {{M|Fogged units}}.
**** {{M|Invisible}} units.
**** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_undying
data.bio_loc:
How long has it been since he lost his name? The torn ruin of his mind no longer knows.

Dimly he recalls armor and banners and grim-faced kin riding at his side. He remembers a battle: pain and fear as pale hands ripped him from his saddle. He remembers terror as they threw him into the yawning pit of the Dead God alongside his brothers, to hear the Dirge and be consumed into nothingness. In the darkness below, time left them. Thought left them. Sanity left them. Hunger, however, did not. They turned on each other with split fingernails and shattered teeth. Then it came: distant at first, a fragile note at the edge of perception, joined by another, then another, inescapable and unending. The chorus grew into a living wall of sound pulsing in his mind until no other thought survived. With the Dirge consuming him, he opened his arms to the Dead God and welcomed his obliteration. Yet destruction was not what he'd been chosen for. The Dead God demanded war. In the belly of the great nothing, he was granted a new purpose: to spread the Dirge across the land, to rally the sleepless dead against the living. He was to become the Undying, the herald of the Dead God, to rise and fall and rise again whenever his body failed him. To trudge on through death unending, that the Dirge might never end.
data.hype_loc: Shambling into battle, Undying forces enemies to decide whether to flee his wrath or be torn apart by it. He drains strength from his foes, and summons a horde of clawing undead. When he finally becomes a hulking flesh golem, his enemies may already be overwhelmed.

abilities.name: undying_decay
abilities.desc_loc: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
abilities.lore_loc: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.
notes_loc: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.

abilities.name: undying_soul_rip
abilities.desc_loc: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
abilities.lore_loc: Even allies feel despair in Undying's presence.
notes_loc: Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.
Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.
facets_loc: Casting Soul Rip on allies increases their Strength by a percentage of Undying's Strength.

abilities.name: undying_tombstone
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
abilities.lore_loc: Dirge calls on his fallen brothers to fight for the Dead God.
notes_loc: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.
abilities.shard_loc: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for %tombstone_bunker_cd% seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for %tombstone_stun_penalty% seconds.

abilities.name: undying_ceaseless_dirge
abilities.desc_loc: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.
abilities.lore_loc: Only when the Dirge of the Dead God ceases will this soldier's march finally end.

abilities.name: undying_flesh_golem
abilities.desc_loc: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
abilities.lore_loc: The flesh of the recently dead add to the power of Dirge's plague.
facets_loc: While transformed into a Flesh Golem, attacks spawn a zombie.
